@echo off
REM ============================================================================
REM  USAIndiaCFO device VERIFY (one file). Double-click to run.
REM  Self-elevates (UAC), then checks the whole setup and self-heals device items.
REM  The verify PowerShell is embedded below as base64 - no other file needed.
REM ============================================================================
net session >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
  powershell -NoProfile -Command "Start-Process -FilePath '%~f0' -Verb RunAs"
  exit /b
)
set "B64=%TEMP%\uic-verify.b64"
set "PS1=%TEMP%\uic-verify.ps1"
if exist "%B64%" del "%B64%"
>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
>>"%B64%" echo 
certutil -f -decode "%B64%" "%PS1%" >nul
del "%B64%" >nul 2>&1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoExit -File "%PS1%"
